visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A plush brown squirrel toy with a large open-mouthed smile and a red tongue sits prominently on a crisp white bed. Two cylindrical pillows featuring a realistic wood-grain log design are placed on either side of the plush squirrel. Dynamic white Chinese text overlays appear floating above the toy in a modern, clean font. (2) A flashback montage shows a family in a brightly lit hotel room at the Grand Cosmos Resort. A woman in a white dress and a young boy in yellow pajamas play on two large beds against a wall featuring a large, colorful mural of animals on a pond. In a tiled bathroom, the boy plays in a tub with colorful toys. A hand holds up a small plastic capsule containing a tiny squirrel figurine. (3) A nighttime scene follows a young boy wearing a blue backpack as he walks along a wooden boardwalk illuminated by strings of warm lights toward several sleek silver Airstream-style camping trailers. This transitions to a wide daytime shot of a turquoise swimming pool at a resort, surrounded by green lawns, palm trees, and a modern curved building under a cloudy sky. (4) The camera pans through the interior of a luxurious camping trailer, showing two wide beds with white linens, orange decorative bolsters, and wooden wall panels. A large white Labrador dog trots across the wooden floor. An outdoor shot captures the family—a woman in a black cap and two young children—standing on a wooden deck next to their trailer during the day. (5) A series of close-ups highlights the food offerings: two whole chickens roasting on a black outdoor grill, followed by a thick pork chop or steak searing on a metal grate. A young woman in a black polo shirt is seen stirring noodles in a pot on a portable induction stove. Two orange bowls filled with noodles and vegetables are shown ready for serving on a dark table. (6) The children enjoy various activities: the boy rides a white carousel horse, and then both kids spin inside a large, yellow-rimmed tea-cup ride. The woman interacts with a young child in a play area filled with giant colorful building blocks. A white dog on a green leash walks on a path between manicured hedges. A dedicated dog bed is tucked neatly under a human bed frame inside the trailer. (7) In a final montage, the boy poses with large statues of a squirrel and a crane on a grassy lawn. A young girl in a blue helmet drives a white toy electric vehicle. The mother smiles excitedly while holding a large roasted chicken leg. The kids play in a pool, and later, the dog is walked at night. The family of three sits on a bench, smiling and waving at the camera.
